description: best-fit allocator over 16 variable-size banks: configure sizes, allocate the smallest bank that fits the request, release space back, count no-fit faults
hardware_advantage: all 16 bank sizes are scanned in one parallel combinational pass so best-fit arbitration is deterministic and cycle-accurate in a single clock with no multiplier: the only arithmetic is a carry-free saturating add through a 33-bit extension and bank indexing is a shift by 3, so the bank table maps straight onto an inferred BRAM register file
provenance: original source authored in this workspace; no third-party RTL imported
qualification: engineering candidate; not certified production or side-channel protection
